notes.title: New update v1.1.2 with bug fixes!
notes.notes:
We are happy to share that we have just uploaded a new update v1.1.2 with minor bug fixes!

Fixed bugs:

- Fixed problem with camera moving to a letter if it is inside the tent
- Fixed problem with flags
- Fixed problem with Flynn getting stuck in rocks in a couple of dioramas

Thanks again for all the support!

notes.title: New A Tiny Sticker Tale v1.1 update with New Content!
notes.notes:
[h1]New A Tiny Sticker Tale v1.1 major update with New Content![/h1]

We are super happy to share a new major update with a lot of new content for A Tiny Sticker Tale!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949761/d4787219b3705fa4295950551d80fe1b025bd25f.png[/img]

Here is a quick summary of everything:
[list]
[*] [b]Flynn's customization[/b], allowing Flynn to customize their look with dresses, hats, accessories, etc
[*] [b]Bigger house to decorate[/b] (2 extra rooms added)
[*] [b]New NPC Merchant[/b], with him players will be able to purchase clothes and accessories, and special Halloween and Christmas items
[*] [b]Halloween special items[/b], available with the Merchant those special items will allow Flynn to decorate with Halloween furniture and there will also be a special sticker to change the environment of any place to Halloween
[*] [b]Christmas special items[/b], available with the Merchant those special items will allow Flynn to decorate with Christmas furniture and there will also be a special sticker to change the environment of any place to Christmas
[/list]
We hope you like this new update!

[b]If you are enjoying A Tiny Sticker Tale please consider leaving a review, that helps a lot![/b]

Steve
Ogre Pixel
[url=https://ogrepixel.com]www.ogrepixel.com[/url]
